One `schema.yaml` per tool under `inst/config/tools/<tool>/`. Class/schema
walkthrough: [nemo
structure](https://tidywf.github.io/nemo/articles/structure.html).

All tools extend `DragenTool` (`nemo::Tool` child), which holds shared parsing,
notably the `dragen-metrics` ftype for headerless
`section,rg,variable,count[,pct]` `*_metrics.csv` files. See [UML](uml.html).

## Why several tools, not one

One tool per DRAGEN output group: `DragenMap`, `DragenCov`, `DragenVar`,
`DragenRna`, `DragenFqc`, `DragenTso`.

- Pipelines produce different subsets; `Dragen` skips absent tools
- One tool = one `schema.yaml` = one output token (e.g.
  `<prefix>_dragencov_finehist`)
- Schemas evolve independently
- Shared logic (`dragen-metrics`/`csv-nohead` ftypes, `refine_files`, fail-loud
  policies) lives on `DragenTool`, so no duplication
